# Winmail.dat Extractor

> Open winmail.dat files in your browser and download the trapped Outlook attachments as a ZIP. Everything runs client-side in the visitor's browser; the selected winmail.dat file is never uploaded to a server.

## Tool
- [Winmail.dat extractor](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/): select a winmail.dat / TNEF file, extract the standard attachments and download them as one ZIP.

## Guides
- [What is a winmail.dat file?](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/what-is-winmail-dat/): A winmail.dat file is an Outlook TNEF container. Learn what is inside it, why your email app cannot read it, and how to recover the real attachments safely.
- [Winmail.dat viewer and opener](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/winmail-dat-viewer/): Use a free online winmail.dat viewer to list the attachments inside a TNEF file before downloading, and learn how to judge any winmail.dat opener.
- [How to open winmail.dat on iPhone and iPad](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/how-to-open-winmail-dat-on-iphone/): Open winmail.dat on iPhone or iPad without installing an app. Save the attachment to Files, extract the Outlook attachments in Safari and open your PDF or Word file.
- [How to open winmail.dat on Android](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/how-to-open-winmail-dat-on-android/): Open a winmail.dat attachment on Android without installing an app. Download the file in Gmail or Outlook, extract the attachments in Chrome and unzip them locally.
- [How to open winmail.dat on Windows 11 and 10](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/how-to-open-winmail-dat-on-windows/): Open winmail.dat on Windows 11 or 10 without Outlook. Extract the TNEF attachments in your browser, or use Outlook or the command line, and get your files back.
- [How to open winmail.dat on a Mac](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/how-to-open-winmail-dat-on-mac/): Apple Mail cannot read Outlook TNEF files. Learn how to open winmail.dat on a Mac using a browser extractor, Outlook for Mac or the Terminal tnef command.
- [How to open winmail.dat in Gmail](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/how-to-open-winmail-dat-in-gmail/): Gmail cannot decode Outlook TNEF attachments. Learn why winmail.dat appears in Gmail and how to extract the real attachments in your browser in under a minute.
- [Convert winmail.dat to ZIP](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/winmail-dat-to-zip/): Convert winmail.dat to a ZIP archive in your browser. Understand what the conversion really does, what the ZIP contains and why some containers cannot be converted.
- [Winmail.dat to PDF: how to get your document back](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/winmail-dat-to-pdf/): You cannot convert winmail.dat to PDF, but you can extract the PDF the sender attached. How to recover it, and what to do when the container holds no PDF.
- [ATT00001.dat and other strangely named attachments](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/att00001-dat-file/): ATT00001.dat, win.dat and Part 1.2 attachments are usually the same Outlook TNEF container as winmail.dat. Learn what they are and how to extract the files inside.
- [How to stop Outlook sending winmail.dat](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/how-to-stop-outlook-sending-winmail-dat/): Stop Outlook creating winmail.dat attachments: change the message format to HTML, fix the Rich Text setting on saved contacts and adjust Exchange TNEF conversion.
- [Is winmail.dat safe to open?](https://winmail-dat-extractor.vercel.app/is-winmail-dat-safe/): A winmail.dat file is a Microsoft container, not malware, but it can carry any attachment. How to check the sender, spot risky file types and extract it safely.
